name: png-to-webp-converter
description: A lightweight, 100% client-side web application for converting PNG images to WebP format. Designed with a striking terminal/console-inspired aesthetic.
author: noviirnawati.work@gmail.com

scripts.build:ext: npm run build:chrome-ext && npm run build:mozilla-ext
scripts.dev:static: npm run build:static && cd static && npx serve -l 8080
scripts.pack:windows: npm run build && cd dist && tar -caf ../build-png2webp.zip * & cd .
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../build-png2webp.zip . & cd .
